scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bbt/protocol test && node --test scripts/verify-release.test.mjs scripts/runtime-lifecycle-report.test.mjs && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs test --manifest-path companion/Cargo.toml --no-fail-fast
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bbt/protocol build && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs check --manifest-path companion/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:mod: node scripts/package-mods.mjs && node scripts/validate-patches.mjs && node scripts/test-mod.mjs
scripts.test:mod:source: node scripts/package-mods.mjs && node scripts/validate-patches.mjs --source-only && node scripts/test-mod.mjs
scripts.test:renderer-visual: node scripts/test-renderer-visual.mjs full && node scripts/test-renderer-visual.mjs clean
